title: Discover the Workflow People Actually Perform
service: FlowMap: observed workflow evidence and explicit variants
runtime: Python3.10+, standard library, pytest; no model, network or real recording decoder

parts.lesson_anchor: Evidence Has Strength four-level ladder; code audit ordering/confidence/direct ratio
planted_bugs: artifact level2 excluded; status surfaces two calls above supports
one directly supported step grounds every step
half-even rounding instead of explicit half-up integer percent
each step display reconstructs all step dictionaries
parts.overfix_guard: confidence never changes evidence level; recorded order not sorted; empty workflow not grounded

parts.lesson_anchor: Start with Current System; store evidence on every workflow step
parts.exactness: Step/Evidence types, evidence tuple order, level integers, exact float confidence and original multilingual text survive reopen
traps: restore typed evidence rather than direct bool
replace only one workflow without old receipts or cross-workflow loss

parts.lesson_anchor: Search for Four Things; failures at handoffs and exceptions
parts.algorithm: enumerate explicit friction/carrier/authority/exception concerns and adjacent-actor handoffs; retain weak leads with evidence flags; fixed risk ordering
traps: weak authority remains visible but unconfirmed
absence of artifact does not infer hidden state
handoff verification requires evidence on both sides

parts.lesson_anchor: Workflow larger than screen includes waiting, copy-paste, side channels and approval
traps: end is last included event; wait belongs to new segment
emit at boundary and flush final segment; equal-time input order

parts.lesson_anchor: Do Not Average Away Disagreement; Exercise4 model two variants without merging them
traps: short observed terminal paths retained with children
observation count differs from distinct users
all real variants and reasons preserved
count-first child order; missing reason unknown

deviations: Four integer evidence levels replace original direct bool, following the actual evidence ladder. The original test rejecting reversed contiguous order remains the contract, rather than silently sorting inputs.

Integer half-up percent is an explicit exercise precision rule, not a claim that the lesson specifies this rounding convention.320 steps replace the suggested5000 so slow rendering remains below3seconds.
Hidden-state carriers, authority text and exception flags are supplied observation fields. Missing artifacts do not infer hidden state; reported authority is retained as an unverified lead.
CSV row serialization and finite actor/action identity normalization are supplied correct helpers; Part4 focuses on segment boundaries/wait and Part5 on keeping genuinely observed variant paths.
Prefix-tree terminal ids and empty paths are deterministic variant representations, not a claim that frequent paths outweigh minority risk or policy disagreement.
